title: pkg/registry/apis/ — control flow map (apiserver builder plumbing)
answers: How do API group builders in pkg/registry/apis get wired into the apiserver?
Where does a request get routed from genericapiserver into Grafana business logic?
What is the entry point for a new API group builder?
How does admission (mutate/validate) dispatch to a specific builder?
body:
Each subpackage of pkg/registry/apis owns one k8s API group (schema, REST storage, admission, authz, OpenAPI). Control flow in:
1. Startup DI: `wireset.go` lists every subpackage's `RegisterAPIService(...)` provider; `apis.go:ProvideRegistryServiceSink` takes a pointer to each builder purely to force Wire to construct it (dummy no-op background service).
2. `RegisterAPIService` builds an `*XxxAPIBuilder` and calls `builder.APIRegistrar.RegisterAPI` (interface `pkg/services/apiserver/builder/common.go:APIRegistrar`), implemented by `pkg/services/apiserver/service.go:(*service).RegisterAPI`, which just appends to `s.builders`.
3. `(*service).start` (service.go) iterates `s.builders`, calls `InstallSchema(scheme)` on each, then `pkg/services/apiserver/builder/helper.go:InstallAPIs` groups builders by group and calls `UpdateAPIGroupInfo` (per-builder, e.g. `folders/register.go`) to populate `VersionedResourcesStorageMap`, then `server.InstallAPIGroup`.
4. Per-request: genericapiserver routes to the `rest.Storage` registered in `UpdateAPIGroupInfo` (built via `pkg/apiserver/registry/generic/storage.go:NewRegistryStoreWithSelectableFields`). Admission runs through `pkg/services/apiserver/builder/admission.go:builderAdmission`, which looks up the request's GroupVersion in `mutators`/`validators` maps and dispatches to the builder's `Mutate`/`Validate` if it implements `APIGroupMutation`/`APIGroupValidation`.
Control flow out: the storage object either talks directly to unified storage (resourcepb/resource.ResourceClient), or is wrapped by a `DualWriteBuilder` (`pkg/services/apiserver/builder/helper.go`, builds legacy+unified dual writes). Builders commonly add their own wrapper on top (e.g. `folderStorage` in folders/register.go, `dashboardStorageWrapper` in dashboard/dashboard_storage.go) for legacy permissions, live-broadcast, cascade delete, before delegating to the base store.
Each builder typically exposes two constructors: `RegisterAPIService` (embedded mode, has the RegisterAPI side effect) vs `NewAPIService` (multi-tenant/standalone, no side effect) — don't conflate them.
